definitions.full: H6554. Parpar מַּרְמַּר proper name, of a river near Damascus 2Kin 5:12 (A) φαρφαρ ; A φαρφαρα ; perhaps modern 'Awaj , south of Damascus Rob BR iii. 447 f .

occurrences.englishText: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them, and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
